repo_notes.content: The most important code is in the volo-vault folder. Focus all analysis, documentation, and workflow explanations on volo-vault. The liquid staking folder is present, but is a lower priority for documentation.
repo_notes.author: Developer

pages.title: Volo Vault Architecture

pages.title: Volo Vault Workflow

pages.title: Volo Vault Core Functions
pages.purpose: Go in depth on the key functions of volo-vault contracts: deposits, withdrawals, rebalancing, yield logic, and internal accounting. Include parameters, returns, and relationships.
